bullets.text: In Pallikaranai, a pet dog was charred to death when a fire broke out from a lamp in an apartment, and the office should monitor residential fire safety.
In Tiruttani, a deaf boy crossing railway tracks to relieve himself in open due to lack of a toilet was hit by a train, requiring office action.
In Thiruvallur, thermal power generation dropped by 1,300 megawatts across plants, and the office should monitor power supply stability during heavy rains and disruptions.

Plans for a new flyover and infrastructure improvements along the Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam Radial Road are considered to ease traffic while protecting the Pallikaranai marshland, which the office should monitor.
Adyar police arrested a history-sheeter for robbing Rs 24 lakh from a pharmaceutical sales manager who was attacked, and the office should watch local crime enforcement.
Collectorate office work in Thiruvallur was paralyzed due to a power outage leaving the office in darkness, and officials should ensure backup power systems are operational.
At a welfare meeting in Tiruttani, a farmer protested that fees are charged per rice bag, and the office should investigate illegal fee collections at procurement centers.
Elderly residents in Ponneri struggled to receive financial aid because their bank accounts were not linked to Aadhaar, and the office should assist with linking accounts.
Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Joseph Vijay inaugurated CapitaLand's Rs 1,940 crore data centre in Ambattur, and the portfolio team should support further digital infrastructure growth.
NITI Aayog and Deloitte India proposed that data centre clearances should depend on power and water availability, which the portfolio team should review for future policies.
Central revenue intelligence officers arrested a TTVK functionary over methamphetamine drug smuggling, causing a stir, and the office should monitor the political fallout.
MK Stalin criticized the TTVK government for omitting the Naan Mudhalvan name in an official report, and the office should watch opposition statements regarding welfare schemes.
